title: Mystic Gate and Sword
description: A human hand in a dark blue velvet sleeve holds an ornate golden sword with intricate details and hanging chains in the foreground. In the background stands a massive stone archway with a heavy metal gate, bound by thick chains and struck by a vertical beam of glowing purple lightning, set against a dramatic night sky with swirling aurora clouds.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene at night showing a hand wearing a dark blue velvet sleeve holding an ornate golden sword with chains in the foreground. In the middle ground is a massive ancient stone wall and arched gateway with a heavy barred metal gate locked by thick black chains. A powerful vertical beam of purple and white lightning strikes the center of the gate. The stormy sky above swirls with dramatic aurora borealis in shades of purple, pink, and green. Mystical runes are carved into the stone blocks. Cinematic lighting, atmospheric, highly detailed digital painting.
